implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure triggers mandatory open offer obligations if the acquirer crosses 26% or if concert-party arrangements breach takeover thresholds; the company and market participants must now await formal open offer notice under Regulation 3 to establish the consideration and offer terms.

headline: Vayu R. Garware discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Vayu R. Garware has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, signalling a material shareholding acquisition or change in control at Garware Technical Fibres Limited.
detail: Vayu R. Garware has submitted formal disclosure documentation to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure of acquisitions that trigger or are likely to trigger open offer obligations. The filing indicates a substantial change in shareholding or control at Garware Technical Fibres Limited, a publicly-listed industrial textiles and advanced composites company. The precise quantum of shares acquired, purchase price, funding structure, and whether an open offer is mandatory remain to be clarified in the acquirer's subsequent formal notice to the Exchange and the company.
